story: East Australian Humpback whale bounces back from near extinction
text: For anyone interested in learning about phytoplankton and other microorganisms, I highly recommend the YouTube series Journey to the Microcosmos , [LINK] For example this video about diatoms, which are responsible for a quarter to half of the oxygen produced on earth, [VIDEO] [LINK] Seeing high-quality video of things moving around gives a much more visceral impression than just reading text interspersed with static images, in my opinion.
Diatoms are fascinating. I recently learned about them from an excellent Journey to the Microcosmos video: [VIDEO]
> So many of the images that are captivating me have been taken at between 50 and 100 times magnification. 300-600x magnification is much better. [VIDEO]
